title: Rushdowncraft
description: A mod that brings elements from the Colour Bass label "Rushdown" into Minecraft!
body:
# **WELCOME TO**

![Rushdowncraft Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/03453dfe8f419866cb55856cdf5fd9b26c44d566.png)

<font color="red">! Please note that this mod is still in Early Access, more features will be added in the future.</font>

## Main credits:

### RUSHDOWN:
- [Website](https://www.chimetunes.net/rushdown)
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@Rushdown)
- [SoundCloud](https://on.soundcloud.com/nGia9MnHS8NjoWEx9)

### modus:
- [Website](https://www.iammod.us/)
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@iammodus)
- [SoundCloud](https://on.soundcloud.com/HxMcbfW5evgFRDuV8)

## Description:

Rushdowncraft is a mod inspired by the iconic colour bass label "RUSHDOWN". It adds a variety of things related to the label to your minecraft world, such as a few disks with Rushdown music, artists from the roster walking around, as well as structures representing some of Rushdown's cover art.

This mod also adds a few members and insiders from modus' community! Their spawning is disabled by default since this mod is mainly about Rushdown. Spawning can be enabled through the custom gamerule "spawnModusCommunity".

You will also be able to encounter a brand new bossfight: **The Protocol**, inspired by modus' [New Year Protocol](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mS_etKjyrdM&list=PLY4S2wY33-q9sPaKsSpLTUbbaFKpBLhNW) series. Eliminating modus will cause it to spawn, this can be disabled with the gamerule "modusSpawnsProtocol".

### featured artists:
- [Chime](https://on.soundcloud.com/tnDHqJECNiBzP2A1A)
- [Convexity](https://on.soundcloud.com/SMH6avc3wst7zkGd8)
- [modus](https://on.soundcloud.com/Sd3dTNUztPb5rJ7y5)
- [Quartzone](https://on.soundcloud.com/z1Zr8Cdf8wi93aKb7)
- [Agente.001](https://on.soundcloud.com/SM2LWywSSCRuWw3Y9)
- [Kosmic Fluid](https://on.soundcloud.com/sVcjKPUTm7ZQyrN39)

## Dependencies:

- Forge for 1.20.1 (tested with 47.4.0)
- [GeckoLib](https://modrinth.com/project/8BmcQJ2H)

## Conflicts:

- <font color="green">Compatible with OptiFine</font>
- <font color="green">Compatible with Rubidium</font>
- <font color="red">Shaders may break GeckoLib animations</font>
- <font color="red">Shaders may break the protocol's see-through texture</font>

It will work with most mods of course, the ones mentioned above are just confirmed to be compatible since they have been used during testing.

## Useful Commands:

### Gamerules:
- modusSpawnsProtocol (Default: true)
  - Enable/Disable the protocol spawning when modus dies.
- spawnModusCommunity (Default: false)
  - Enable/Disable the spawning of modus' community members.
- playProtocolMusic (default: true)
  - Enable/Disable the [Protocol bossfight music](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CECrCxUd8ug&list=PLY4S2wY33-q9sPaKsSpLTUbbaFKpBLhNW&index=11).

### Other:
- /kill protocol
  - Despawns every Protocol.

## How this mod came to be:

Originally, this mod started as a small meme. I added modus into minecraft and posted a video of that in [his Discord server](https://discord.com/invite/4KQk2pqwmy). Suprisingly, modus responded, saying he'd play this mod live if i add a few more features. So i spent the next 3 weeks creating this mod, until i had made what we now know as Rushdowncraft.
